# Script to read and process CCLE Proteomics metadata
https://www.cell.com/cell/fulltext/S0092-8674(19)31385-6

Data downloaded from https://www.cell.com/cms/10.1016/j.cell.2019.12.023/attachment/a1ddd097-0162-471d-9725-fa0e3d9249a4/mmc1.xlsx,
accessed on 26 May 2026, 8:45.

Processing: Download Cellosaurus.txt if not present, map sample names to Cellosaurus accessions, retrieve metadata, process it.

```{r}
library(magrittr)
library(dplyr)
library(readxl)
library(readr)
library(tibble)
library(stringr)
library(purrr)
```

```{r}
proteomics_meta <- 
    read_xlsx(
        "../data/CCLE_Proteomics/mmc1.xlsx",
        sheet = "Sample_Information"
    ) 

head(proteomics_meta)
```

```{r prepare_cellosaurus}
cellosaurus_path <- "../data/cellosaurus.txt"
cellosaurus_url <- "https://ftp.expasy.org/databases/cellosaurus/cellosaurus.txt"

if (!file.exists(cellosaurus_path)) {
  raw_cellosaurus_path <- tempfile(fileext = ".txt")
  download.file(cellosaurus_url, destfile = raw_cellosaurus_path, mode = "wb")

  raw_lines <- readLines(raw_cellosaurus_path, warn = FALSE, encoding = "UTF-8")
  if (length(raw_lines) <= 57) {
    stop("Downloaded Cellosaurus file is shorter than expected.")
  }

  processed_lines <- raw_lines[-seq_len(57)]
  writeLines(processed_lines, cellosaurus_path, useBytes = TRUE)
}

cellosaurus_first_line <- readLines(cellosaurus_path, n = 1, warn = FALSE, encoding = "UTF-8")
if (length(cellosaurus_first_line) != 1 || !grepl("^ID\\s+#", cellosaurus_first_line)) {
  stop("Prepared Cellosaurus file failed verification: expected the first line to start with 'ID   #'.")
}
```

```{r read_cellosaurus}

entries <- str_split(cellosaurus, "(?m)^//\\s*$")[[1]]
entries <- entries[nzchar(str_trim(entries))]

parse_entry <- function(block) {
  # ID: recommended name (one line)
  id <- str_match(block, "(?m)^ID\\s+(.+)$")[, 2]

  # AC: first accession on the AC line
  ac <- str_match(block, "(?m)^AC\\s+([^;\\s]+)")[, 2]

  # SY: zero or more lines; each may contain many synonyms separated by ';'
  sy_lines <- str_match_all(block, "(?m)^SY\\s+(.+)$")[[1]]
  sy_raw <- if (nrow(sy_lines)) sy_lines[, 2] else character(0)
  sy_vec <- if (length(sy_raw)) unlist(str_split(sy_raw, "\\s*;\\s*")) else character(0)
  sy_vec <- sy_vec[sy_vec != ""]

  # Build rows: one row for ID + one per synonym (if any)
  tibble(
    id = ifelse(length(id), id, NA_character_),
    ac = ifelse(length(ac), ac, NA_character_),
    name_or_synonym = c(ifelse(length(id), id, character(0)), sy_vec)
  )
}

if (!file.exists("../data/cellosaurus_entry_lookup.RData")) {
    entry_lookup <- map_dfr(entries, parse_entry) %>%
        filter(!is.na(ac), !is.na(name_or_synonym)) %>%
        distinct(ac, name_or_synonym, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
        mutate(name_or_synonym = toupper(name_or_synonym)) %>%
        mutate(name_or_synonym = sub("^#", "", name_or_synonym)) %>%
        select(ac, id, name_or_synonym)

    save(entry_lookup, file = "../data/cellosaurus_entry_lookup.RData")
} else {
    load("../data/cellosaurus_entry_lookup.RData")
}

head(entry_lookup)
```

```{r}
# map cell line names to Cellosaurus entries
# map Cellosaurus accessions to Shorthouse_2022 cell line names by the name or synonym
cell_lines <- 
    data.frame(
        name = proteomics_meta$`Cell Line`,
        name_normalized = toupper(proteomics_meta$`Cell Line` %>%
            gsub(" ", "", .) %>%
            gsub("-", "", .))
    ) %>%
    left_join(
        entry_lookup %>% select(ac, id, name_or_synonym),
        by = c("name" = "name_or_synonym")
    ) %>%
    left_join(
        entry_lookup %>% select(ac, id, name_or_synonym),
        by = c("name_normalized" = "name_or_synonym"),
        suffix = c("", "_normalized")
    ) %>%
    mutate(
        ac = coalesce(ac, ac_normalized),
        id = coalesce(id, id_normalized),
        matched = !is.na(ac)
    ) %>%
    select(-ac_normalized, -id_normalized, -name_normalized)

cell_lines[!cell_lines$matched, c("name")]
```

```{r}
# assess matches of proteomics cell line names to cellosaurus accessions
# 37 are not matched

## Manual matches in the same shape as `cell_lines`
manual_matches <- tibble::tribble(
  ~name,                          ~ac,         ~id,                           ~matched,
  "Hep 3B2.1-7",                  "CVCL_0326", "Hep 3B2.1-7",                 TRUE,
  "Hs 944.T",                     "CVCL_1040", "Hs 944.T",                    TRUE,
  "CNI-H1568",                    "CVCL_1476", "NCI-H1568",                   TRUE,
  "PE/CA-PJ34 (clone C12)",       "CVCL_2679", "PE/CA-PJ34 (clone C12)",      TRUE,
  "Ishikawa (Heraklio) 02 ER-",   "CVCL_6543", "Ishikawa (Heraklio) 02 ER-",  TRUE,
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(n_matched = 1L)

## Remove ONLY the unmatched placeholders for these names
cell_lines_working <- cell_lines %>%
    filter(matched != FALSE)

## Append the manual rows
cell_lines_working <- dplyr::bind_rows(cell_lines_working, manual_matches)

## drop duplicates and add n_matched column
# n_matched counts how often a cell line name was matched to a cellosaurus accession 
cell_lines_working <- cell_lines_working %>%
  dplyr::distinct(name, ac, id, .keep_all = TRUE)

cell_lines_working <- cell_lines_working %>%
  group_by(name) %>%
  mutate(n_matched = n()) %>%
  ungroup()

print(unique(cell_lines_working[cell_lines_working$n_matched > 1, "name"]), n=100)

# multiple-match cell line names:
# HEL				
# ABC-1				
# HT55				
# PC-3				
# COLO205				
# U-87 MG				
# 697				
# TE-4				
# JM1

preferred_map <- tibble::tribble(
  ~name,        ~preferred_ac,
  "HEL",        "CVCL_0001",
  "ABC-1",      "CVCL_1066",
  "HT55",       "CVCL_1294",
  "PC-3",       "CVCL_0035",
  "COLO205",    "CVCL_0218",
  "U-87 MG",    "CVCL_0022",
  "697",        "CVCL_0079",
  "TE-4",       "CVCL_3337",
  "JM1",        "CVCL_3532"
)

cell_lines_working <- cell_lines_working %>%
  group_by(name) %>%
  summarise(
    # collapse ac and id side by side in the same order
    ac_list = paste(ac[order(ac)], collapse = "; "),
    id_list = paste(id[order(ac)], collapse = "; "),
    n_matched = dplyr::n_distinct(ac),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cell_lines_working <- cell_lines_working %>%
  # join in preferred mapping
  left_join(preferred_map, by = "name") %>%
  mutate(
    ac_preferred = dplyr::coalesce(
      preferred_ac,                              # use curated choice if exists
      if_else(n_matched == 1, ac_list, NA_character_)  # otherwise, reuse ac_list if only one
    )
  ) %>%
  select(-preferred_ac)


cell_lines_df <- cell_lines_working
```

```{r Cellosaurus_API_call}

query_fields <- "id, sy, ac, acas, sequence-variation, cell-type, derived-from-site, part-of, ca, di"

fetch_cellosaurus_one <- function(ac, fields) {
  if (is.na(ac) || ac == "") {
    return(tibble())
  }
  
  message("Fetching accession: ", ac)
  
  resp_txt <- httr::GET(
    url = sprintf("https://api.cellosaurus.org/cell-line/%s", ac),
    query = list(fields = fields, format = "tsv")
  ) %>% httr::content(as = "text", encoding = "UTF-8")
  
  # Force all columns to character to avoid type mismatch
  df <- read_tsv(resp_txt, show_col_types = FALSE,
                 col_types = readr::cols(.default = "c"))
  
  # Quick sanity check
  # print(head(df))
  
  return(df)
}

api_results <- purrr::map_dfr(
    cell_lines_df$ac_preferred,
    ~fetch_cellosaurus_one(.x, query_fields)
)

cell_lines_df_joined <- cell_lines_df %>%
  left_join(unique(api_results), by = c("ac_preferred" = "ac"))

```

```{r extract_mutation_info}

extract_genes <- function(seqvar_col) {
  
  if (is.na(seqvar_col)) {
    return(NA_character_)
  }
  
  # split separate events
  muts <- unlist(strsplit(seqvar_col, "\\|"))
  
  genes <- unlist(lapply(muts, function(m) {
    
    parts <- strsplit(m, ";")[[1]]
    parts <- trimws(parts)
    
    # standard entries
    gene_idx <- which(parts == "HGNC")
    
    if (length(gene_idx) > 0) {
      
      # gene names are typically 2 positions after HGNC
      candidate_idx <- gene_idx + 2
      candidate_idx <- candidate_idx[candidate_idx <= length(parts)]
      
      genes_found <- parts[candidate_idx]
      
      # remove HGNC IDs accidentally captured
      genes_found <- genes_found[!grepl("^HGNC:", genes_found)]
      
      # split fusion genes
      genes_found <- unlist(strsplit(genes_found, "\\+"))
      genes_found <- trimws(genes_found)
      
      return(genes_found)
    }
    
    NA_character_
  }))
  
  genes <- unique(na.omit(genes))
  
  paste(genes, collapse = "; ")
}

cell_lines_df_extracted <- cell_lines_df_joined %>%
  mutate(
    mutated_genes = vapply(`sequence-variation`,
                           extract_genes,
                           character(1))
  ) %>%
  unique()

```

```{r join_back_to_data}

proteomics_meta_extended <- 
    proteomics_meta %>%
    merge(
        .,
        cell_lines_df_extracted %>% 
            select(
                name,
                "Cellosaurus.ac_preferred" = "ac_preferred",
                "Cellosaurus.sequence-variation" = "sequence-variation",
                "Cellosaurus.mutated_genes" = "mutated_genes",
                "Cellosaurus.disease" = "di",
                "Cellosaurus.derived_from_site" = "derived-from-site",
                "Cellosaurus.cell_type" = `cell-type`
            ),
        by.x = "Cell Line",
        by.y = "name",
        all.x = TRUE    
    )
```


```{r saving}
save(proteomics_meta_extended, file = "../data/proteomics_meta_extended.RData")
write_csv(proteomics_meta_extended, "../data/CCLE_proteomics_metadata_extended.csv")
```
